thought.text: Lass mich VPS mit lokal vergleichen:

reasoning_content:
Found it! The function returns `{ ids, chunks }` - an object with both `ids` (Set) and `chunks` (array). But WorldTick calls `.map()` on it, expecting just an array.

In locally I need to fix WorldTick to use `observedChunks.chunks` instead of just `observedChunks`.

Actually wait - this is the LOCAL version that works for me. The VPS might have a DIFFERENT version with the bug. Let me check the VPS version vs local version.
